objective: Polish the weak Night Blender assets (masks, demon wing, koi, wisp, sacred tree, boss hand), add an Open Cloud upload workflow for the committed FBX/PNG files, and prepare the code swap: every Night visual reads one NightAssets table keyed by manifest name and falls back to today's visuals while ids are nil.
inputs: Roblox Open Cloud Assets API docs (create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/guides/usage-assets)
acceptance_criteria: Six masks have sculpted face shells with brow, cheekbones, carved eye holes, noses/horns/teeth and ties; demon_wing has finger bones and a scalloped membrane; koi has a forked tail and tapered body; wisp flames are smooth; sacred_tree canopy spreads about 44 studs; boss_hand is 16 studs tall
assets/night/ holds <asset>.fbx and <asset>.png for every manifest asset
.github/workflows/upload-assets.yml (workflow_dispatch, environment assets) uploads them and writes uploaded.json and NightAssets.luau as an artifact
src/shared/NightAssets.luau is generated by tools/blender/night/write-assets-module.mjs; with nil ids the game runs exactly as before
Every Night model is placed with its lowest point on the ground, at the manifest size; stage and bridge keep their collision parts; blades stay separate and tinted
docs/assets/register.md has a row per asset
verification: lune run tests/run, stylua --check, selene, rojo build night.project.json, node tools/validate-tasks.mjs; review the contact sheet; after the upload run, playtest Night with the generated NightAssets.luau
notes: Upload is run by the Director after merge (needs the assets environment, CLAUDE.md rules 6 and 7). Models load with InsertService:LoadAsset, so the creator user must own the Night experience.
